item.title: Using EXT JS grid data with BI Publisher
item.description: EXT JS is a powerful Javascript Framework which provides a lot of visual components like Grid, forms and Windows. The grid family is especially rich. I used it in combination with BI PUblisher XML Output in order to render data in a grid component.
